key_findings: Dietary GSE suppressed odor-induced orofacial and hindpaw mechanical nociception in stress-primed rats of both sexes, reversed by intracisternal CB1 or CB2 antagonists.
GSE blocked odor-stimulated CGRP increase in the spinal trigeminal nucleus.
